name: SEO Profile
description: Interviews a site owner step by step (product, audience, languages, facts, themes to rank for and searches to avoid, writing rules, Git repository or CMS, Search Console and Google Trends sources, cadence, notification), asking only what the installed SEO skills need, and writes the validated .seo/profile.json every SEO skill reads. Also holds what they share: connectors, action tracker, autocomplete and deck scripts.
